name: data-grid
purpose: An editable, spreadsheet-like grid: rows of records and typed columns where people move a cell cursor with the keyboard, edit cells in place, select ranges and copy them, the way an SQL editor's results and a database table editor work. It shares the table's visual language (header band, row dividers, row selection, a pinned first column, the same tokens) but renders the WAI-ARIA **grid** pattern (`role="grid"`, `gridcell`, one roving tab stop), not a read-only table. **Why a component of its own.** DataGrid is not an `editable` mode of `data-table` and is not composed from `table`'s parts, for three reasons. Table's parts render the **table** pattern (`role="table"`, `cell`, every link and button its own tab stop), while a grid needs `gridcell`s inside one roving tab stop with a cell cursor; switching the roles and the focus model inside the same parts would make every read-only table pay for it. In-cell editors must be borderless and fill the cell, so they are a bare `input` and `select` styled with the tokens, not the package's `Input` and `Select`, whose frames and overlays fight a 40 px cell. And DataGrid needs no sorting, filtering or paging engine: it loads no `@tanstack/vue-table` and no virtualization library, so an editing screen stays at about 9 KB. **The rows are the edited value.** Where `data-table` takes `data` and only emits `update:data` when rows are reordered, DataGrid's rows are what the person edits, so they are its `v-model`: every committed edit writes a new array with a copy of the edited row, and `change` reports the cell, the new value and the previous one. Adding and deleting rows are hooks: the grid emits `row-add` and `row-delete` and the app changes the rows. Thousands of rows scroll natively inside `maxHeight`, each row is laid out lazily with CSS `content-visibility: auto`, and each row re-renders only when its cells, its cursor or its range change.
useWhen: Use DataGrid only when people edit many cells of many records in place, spreadsheet-style; for a short list of rows in a form use AttributeEditor, for read-and-act lists use DataTable (a hand-composed Table for small static ones).
A database table editor or the editable results of a query: typed cells (text, number, boolean, a choice), keyboard-first editing, copy of a cell range.
Bulk corrections across rows, where opening a drawer per record would be slower than editing the cells.
avoidWhen: People read, sort, filter, select and act on records but do not edit cells → use `data-table` (or a hand-composed `table`).
A short list of same-field rows added and removed inside a form (environment variables, headers) → use `attribute-editor`.
One record edited field by field → use a form with `field` controls.
Key and value pairs shown for reading → use `key-value-list`.
related: data-table` — the read-and-act table (sorting, filters, paging, toolbar parts); DataGrid is its editable counterpart.
table` — the parts and tokens DataGrid shares its look with.
attribute-editor` — a few rows of the same fields inside a form.
collection-preferences` — the display preferences of a list; DataGrid's column widths are dragged in place instead.
bestPractices: Give every row a stable id under `row-key` (default `'id'`): the cursor, the selection and the edits follow it.
Type each column (`text`, `number`, `boolean`, `select`) so the editor matches the value; mark computed or key columns `editable: false`.
Freeze the first column (`frozen-first-column`) when it names the row and the grid scrolls sideways.
Keep adding and deleting in the app: handle `row-add` and `row-delete`, then write the new rows to the `v-model`. Confirm a delete of more than a few rows in a `confirm-dialog`.
Use `readonly` while saving or for people who may not edit; the cursor, selection and copy still work.

props.name: columns
props.doc: Columns in order: `{ id, header, type?, options?, editable?, width?, minWidth?, align? }`; `type` picks the editor (default text).

props.name: rowKey
props.doc: Field used as the stable row id (cursor, selection and edits follow it).

props.name: enableRowSelection
props.doc: Adds a leading checkbox column with Select all.

props.name: frozenFirstColumn
props.doc: Pins the first data column to the inline start edge while the grid scrolls sideways.

props.name: readonly
props.doc: No cell can be edited; the cursor, range selection and copy still work.

props.name: maxHeight
props.doc: Max height (CSS length) of the scrolling viewport; the header stays on top.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the grid when no visible heading names it.

events.name: change
events.notes: A cell edit was committed (Enter, Tab, blur, a toggle); `edit` is `{ row, columnId, value, previous }`.

events.name: row-add
events.notes: The `add` function of the toolbar slot ran; the app appends a row to the `v-model`.

events.name: row-delete
events.notes: The `remove` function of the toolbar slot ran with rows selected; the app removes them from the `v-model`.

events.name: copy
events.notes: Ctrl+C or Cmd+C copied the selected cell range as tab-separated text (rows by line), also written to the clipboard.

slots.name: toolbar
slots.scope: { selectedRows: TRow[]; selectedCount: number; add: (event: Event) => void; remove: (event: Event) => void }
slots.notes: Action band above the grid (add and delete buttons); `add` and `remove` emit the row hooks.

slots.name: empty
slots.notes: Shown in place of the rows when there are none. Defaults to a small `EmptyState`.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DataGrid from '@aziontech/webkit/data-grid'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const rows = ref([
    { id: '1', name: 'Acme Inc.', plan: 'business', seats: 12, active: true },
    { id: '2', name: 'Jane Doe', plan: 'free', seats: 1, active: true },
    { id: '3', name: 'John Smith', plan: 'pro', seats: 3, active: false },
    { id: '4', name: 'Priya Patel', plan: 'pro', seats: 5, active: true },
    { id: '5', name: 'Sam Lee', plan: 'free', seats: 1, active: false }
  ])

  const columns = [
    { id: 'name', header: 'Name', type: 'text', width: 200 },
    {
      id: 'plan',
      header: 'Plan',
      type: 'select',
      options: [
        { label: 'Free', value: 'free' },
        { label: 'Pro', value: 'pro' },
        { label: 'Business', value: 'business' }
      ]
    },
    { id: 'seats', header: 'Seats', type: 'number', align: 'end', width: 120 },
    { id: 'active', header: 'Active', type: 'boolean', width: 120 },
    { id: 'id', header: 'ID', editable: false, width: 96 }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <DataGrid
    v-model="rows"
    :columns="columns"
    aria-label="Customers"
    frozen-first-column
  />
</template>

examples.name: RowSelection
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import DataGrid from '@aziontech/webkit/data-grid'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const rows = ref([
    { id: 'r1', host: 'app.example.com', ttl: 3600, proxied: true },
    { id: 'r2', host: 'api.example.com', ttl: 300, proxied: true },
    { id: 'r3', host: 'docs.example.com', ttl: 3600, proxied: false }
  ])
  const selection = ref({})
  let next = 4

  const columns = [
    { id: 'host', header: 'Host', width: 220 },
    { id: 'ttl', header: 'TTL (seconds)', type: 'number', align: 'end', width: 140 },
    { id: 'proxied', header: 'Proxied', type: 'boolean', width: 120 }
  ]

  const addRow = () => {
    rows.value = [...rows.value, { id: `r${next++}`, host: '', ttl: 3600, proxied: false }]
  }
  const deleteRows = (event, removed) => {
    const ids = new Set(removed.map((row) => row.id))
    rows.value = rows.value.filter((row) => !ids.has(row.id))
    selection.value = {}
  }
</script>

<template>
  <DataGrid
    v-model="rows"
    v-model:row-selection="selection"
    :columns="columns"
    aria-label="DNS records"
    enable-row-selection
    @row-add="addRow"
    @row-delete="deleteRows"
  >
    <template #toolbar="{ add, remove, selectedCount }">
      <Button
        label="Add row"
        icon="pi pi-plus"
        kind="outlined"
        size="small"
        @click="add"
      />
      <Button
        label="Delete rows"
        kind="outlined"
        size="small"
        :disabled="selectedCount === 0"
        @click="remove"
      />
    </template>
  </DataGrid>
</template>

examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DataGrid from '@aziontech/webkit/data-grid'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const rows = ref([
    { id: '1', path: '/assets/logo.svg', size: 4096, cached: true },
    { id: '2', path: '/index.html', size: 18230, cached: false },
    { id: '3', path: '/app.js', size: 254880, cached: true }
  ])

  const columns = [
    { id: 'path', header: 'Path', width: 220 },
    { id: 'size', header: 'Size (bytes)', type: 'number', align: 'end', width: 140 },
    { id: 'cached', header: 'Cached', type: 'boolean', width: 120 }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <DataGrid
    v-model="rows"
    :columns="columns"
    aria-label="Objects"
    readonly
  />
</template>
